name: rune_hexer
for: hexer 'rune' (fight.rs HEXER, area attack, AREA_HALF 1.1 m)
notes: Violet glyph circle on the ground plane (flattened ellipse ~136 px = 2.1 m across, which is the hit patch): frame 1 is empty, then frames 2-12 fade in faintly (ring, turning glyph band, pentagram) and brighten, frame 13 cracks race across it and the glyphs flare, frame 15 is the eruption (the hit): jagged violet shards burst up through the cracks to ~1.8 m with sparks and rubble, then crumble away by frame 22. Anchor = the patch centre on the ground. 24 frames @ 12 fps (2 s): to match the 78-tick windup, hold or stretch frames 2-12, never the eruption.
